chunks: From him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: Ibn Abi Umayr, a prominent narrator of hadith
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Halabi, a narrator known as Muhammad ibn Abi Nasah al-Halabi
key_terms.حَمَّادٌ: Hammad ibn Uthman, a companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithluhu' mean in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This is a concise hadith from the book Tahdhib al-Ahkam, indicating that the ruling or narration previously mentioned is repeated or identical to the current one. It serves as a reference to a preceding text within the chapter on hunting and slaughter.
